package_owner: CFTC Regulation CTX and CAM — 2026 ANPRM
title: CFTC Regulation CTX/CAM — Source and Publication-State Manifest
subject: Regulation Crypto Asset Transactions and Regulation Crypto Asset Markets
purpose: Separate controlling, framing, statutory, current-system, comparator and stakeholder sources while preserving the not-public state of the ANPRM and docket.
scope_boundary: Official public sources reached through October 5, 2026 EDT. No public ANPRM text, Federal Register document number, document-specific docket, numbered question set or proposed CFR text is claimed.
authority_rule: The Federal Register ANPRM and Commission-approved public text will control the proposal. CFTC announcements and statements establish framing; OIRA establishes executive-review metadata; current rules and filings establish the control group; comment submissions establish stakeholder positions only.

sources.title: OIRA Conclusion of EO 12866 Regulatory Review — RIN 3038-AF80
sources.authority: Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs
sources.boundary: Establishes title, RIN, prerule stage, Consistent with Change conclusion, Dodd-Frank flag and review classification; does not disclose draft text or changes.

sources.title: CFTC Seeks Public Comment on Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking Relating to Regulation Crypto Asset Transactions and Regulation Crypto Asset Markets
sources.boundary: Establishes the announced ANPRM, section 2(c)(2)(D) CTX hook, contemplated CAM DCM subcategory, high-level comment topics and relative 60-day clock. It is not the full ANPRM text.

sources.title: WSJ Op-Ed | CFTC's New Rules for Crypto
sources.boundary: Chairman's policy and authority framing, including elective federal venue and ordinary spot-market ceiling; not Commission rule text.

sources.title: Regulation Crypto Asset Transactions and Regulation Crypto Asset Markets — Federal Register ANPRM
sources.authority: Commodity Futures Trading Commission and Office of the Federal Register
sources.boundary: Return gate. Do not infer text, questions, CFR parts, authority analysis or economics before publication.

sources.title: Regulation CTX/CAM comment docket
sources.boundary: Return gate for public comments, meeting materials, supplements, corrections and comment deadline.

sources.title: Commodity Exchange Act section 2(c)(2)(D) — Retail commodity transactions
sources.boundary: Existing statutory hook and exceptions; not CAM implementing text.

sources.title: Designated Contract Markets
sources.boundary: Current DCM designation, twenty-three core principles and ongoing oversight; CAM may adapt but does not yet replace this shell.

sources.title: Listing Procedures and Rules and Rule Amendments
sources.boundary: Current Rule 40.2/40.3 product and Rule 40.5/40.6 rule routes; the ANPRM must establish whether CAM/CTX uses or changes them.

sources.title: Derivatives Clearing Organization registration and core principles
sources.boundary: Current clearing control group; does not prove CAM clearing requirements.

sources.title: FCM and IB registration, membership, customer funds and records
sources.boundary: Current intermediary and ordinary futures customer-fund control group; CAM customer-property treatment remains text-pending.

sources.title: Bitnomial Exchange Spot Trading Rules and Related Updates
sources.authority: Bitnomial Exchange LLC filing with CFTC
sources.boundary: Nearest current DCM spot comparator and stakeholder rule design; not CAM or Commission merits approval.

sources.title: Bitnomial Bitcoin US Dollar Spot Contract certification
sources.authority: Bitnomial Exchange LLC filing with CFTC
sources.boundary: Product self-certification and intended launch; not Commission approval or independent trade-tape evidence.

sources.title: Retail Commodity Transactions Involving Certain Digital Assets
sources.boundary: Historical possession-and-control interpretation; withdrawn and not current Commission guidance.

sources.title: Withdrawal of Interpretive Guidance: Retail Commodity Transactions Involving Certain Digital Assets
sources.boundary: Withdraws the crypto-specific interpretation as likely outdated; leaves the statute and statutory exception in place.

sources.title: Comments for Request for Input on Listing of Spot Crypto Asset Contracts
sources.boundary: Administrative record and issue locator; individual submissions are stakeholder positions, not Commission conclusions.

sources.title: Selected official comment submissions on listed spot crypto
sources.authority: Stakeholders filing in CFTC comment record
sources.boundary: Coinbase, Bitnomial, a16z, Kraken and Solidus positions identify design disputes; none is Regulation CTX/CAM text.

return_requirements: populate controlling ANPRM URL, document number, docket, pages, bytes and SHA-256
preserve official PDF and machine-readable text
record Commission vote and commissioner statements
recover every numbered and embedded question
separate contemplated alternatives from proposed or amendatory text
populate all stable provision IDs in CFTC_CTX_CAM_PROPOSAL_TO_FINAL_BASELINE_2026-10-05.json
